svg.aria-label: PgQueue: Durable Job Queue on PostgreSQL with zero duplicate pickups. Concurrent workers claim jobs with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Lease-based crash recovery with worker heartbeats, expiry reaper, and chaos testing. Built with Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker.
